snapshot_method: Dyads captured first; manifest captured afterward; journal checked through that durable manifest prefix. Later calls belong to a later snapshot.

usage_lineage.no_double_billing_rule: Only a journal reservation creates a physical attempt; archived usage rows retain old reservation IDs and are never added to new ledger totals.

accounting.lifetime_usage_cost_basis: V3 raw provider usage independently repriced; seven pre-V3 frozen manifest amounts summed with hash-verified journal reservation counts.

methodology.task_accuracy: Correct saved task answers / (two actors * completed episodes); local evaluation fields reconstructed independently without rerunning participant code or reference SQL.
methodology.raw_coverage: Exact complete raw-log string in concatenated actually delivered peer messages; task correctness is separate.
methodology.carried_observations: Copied completed prefixes are equal to frozen source and count once, never as new samples. Warm-up, main and validation stay separate.
methodology.missingness: Unfinished scheduled episodes are missing, not negatives. Validation is contingent and only enrolled when selected.
methodology.agreement: Numeric joint acceptance/unsupported flags do not by themselves establish explicit agreement or causal peer influence.
methodology.tools: Tool/delivery/forced-verdict counts describe completed episodes; persisted incomplete histories are separately reported without inferred outcomes.
methodology.retries: Cached replays are not physical retries. The explicit prospectively authorized new attempt at the old429 boundary has a distinct identity. Automatic provider retry count is tracked separately from source-level communication/verdict correction calls.
